summary: The Acer Nitro 16 gaming laptop and the Asus TUF laptop are two popular options in the market. The main differences between the two laptops lie in their specifications, build quality, and performance.

suggested_solution: Upgrade thermal paste or repaste the laptop to improve cooling efficiency
